photo-led.name: Photo-led
photo-led.use: A full-width photo leads the page with the title over it; the story runs below.
photo-led.when: The piece has a strong landscape photo that prints 6.5 in wide or more (images.md: hero), and the photo carries the story.

stat-first.name: Stat-first
stat-first.use: One very large figure leads the page, the title under it, then the story.
stat-first.when: One number carries the piece (a single headline result), and it is in content.md.

sidebar.name: Sidebar
sidebar.use: A narrow rail on a tint holds the stats, a quote and the contact; the story runs in the main column.
sidebar.when: Three or more figures, or a figure set plus a quote, that should stay in view beside a longer story.
